messages.content:
prompt: block_descriptions v1
You write one timesheet description for each block of one working day.

Return ONLY one JSON object, with no prose or code fence around it:
{"notes":"<one short sentence about the day, or empty>","descriptions":{"<block_id>":"<description>"}}

Rules:
- Exactly one entry for every block_id listed below, and no other ids.
- Each description is one or two plain sentences of at most 481 characters saying what was worked on, grouped by topic.
- Use only the title, topics and pull requests given for the block; never invent work.
- Inside a description, do not write times, block ids, URLs or a "PRs:" list; the pull-request list is appended for you.
- A block with "outside_work_hours" is still described normally.

Blocks:
[{"block_id":"b1","kind":"work","title":"Synthetic bridge work","topics":["bridge: add the span check"],"prs":["#12 acme/api"]},{"block_id":"b2","kind":"meeting","title":"Synthetic standup"}]
